blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Learning from large-model demonstrations offers a way to train
small agents that can complete recurring tasks without calling
a large model at every step.
A central design choice is what to retain from teacher trajectories
that contain reasoning, actions, and information about task progress.
We introduce Task-Progress Distillation (TPD), an offline approach
that pairs each demonstrated action with a short label describing
the current task stage.
The student learns these compact targets and selects actions by
jointly scoring admissible stage–action pairs, which a deterministic
harness executes in the environment.
On ALFWorld, a 1.7B student trained with 404 demonstrations achieves
72.4% mean unseen task success with either TPD or action-only
supervision, compared with 48.3% for a reasoning-trained student
using constrained action selection.
Explicit stages provide an additional benefit at 200 demonstrations,
improving success from 48.0% to 67.7% over action-only supervision.
With more demonstrations, the action-only student closes the gap,
and both approaches reach 76.9% at 808 demonstrations.
Shared-history analyses link part of TPD’s local advantage to
better decisions when moving between subgoals, particularly from
object acquisition to processing.
These results show that compact supervision can train effective
small task agents, while explicit task progress provides additional
guidance at an intermediate demonstration budget.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
For recurring tasks, a large model can provide demonstrations from which a smaller model learns to act on its own.
The aim is for the student to complete new instances without asking the teacher to choose each action.
The teacher trajectories in our setting contain reasoning, actions, and feedback that records how the task progresses.
With limited demonstrations, the choice of what the student should learn becomes central.
blocks.zh:
对于反复出现的任务,一个大的模型可以提供示范,一个较小的模型从中学会自己行动.
目的是让学生在不要求老师选择每个动作的情况下完成新的实例.
我们环境中的教师轨迹 包含了推理、动作和反馈 记录了任务的进展情况
由于示威活动有限,选择学生应该学习什么成为中心.

blocks.en:
Action imitation already provides a useful foundation.
LM-BUTLER shows that action modeling can train effective ALFWorld agents, while FireAct and AgentTuning learn from language-model trajectories and broader agent data Micheli and Fleuret (2021) ; Chen et al. (2023) ; Zeng et al. (2024) .
Other methods separate reasoning and action losses or adjust token updates to change how the student learns from each trajectory Liu et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) .
Online learning offers another source of improvement: the student can collect experience beyond the initial demonstrations Feng et al. (2025) ; Peng et al. (2026) .
We keep the student’s demonstrations fixed and compare which training targets best support task execution.
blocks.zh:
行动模仿已经提供了一个有用的基础。
LM-BUTLER显示,动作模型可以训练有效的ALFWorld代理,而FireAct和AgentTuning则从语言模型轨迹和更广泛的代理数据Micheri和Fleuret(2021)中学习; 陈等 (2023); 曾等 (2024).
其他方法将推理和动作损失分开或调整符号更新,以改变学生从每个轨迹刘等(2025)学习的方式;刘等(2026).
在线学习提供了另一个改进来源:学生可以收集到冯等(2025年);彭等(2026年)之后的经验.

blocks.en:
Our approach combines compact supervision with constrained action selection.
We train the student to predict the next executable action from the task instruction and action–feedback history.
At execution time, the student scores the actions allowed by the environment and selects one to execute.
The action-only variant (C) uses this action as its entire decision target.
Task-Progress Distillation (TPD, arm B) adds a short label for the current task stage: finding the target, processing it, or delivering it.
TPD scores stage–action pairs; a deterministic execution harness sends the selected action to the environment and records its feedback.
blocks.zh:
我们的办法把严格监督与有限的行动选择结合起来。
我们训练学生从任务指令和行动 — — 反馈历史中预测下一个可执行的行动。
执行时,学生会给环境允许的动作打分,选择一个执行.
只行动变体(C)使用此动作作为其整个决策目标.
任务进度分解(TPD, arm B)为当前任务阶段增加了一个短标签:找到目标,处理或交付.
TPD 评分阶段 - 动作配对; 决定性的执行工具将选定的动作传送到环境并记录其反馈.

blocks.en:
Stage labels address a common difficulty in multi-step tasks: moving from one subgoal to the next.
Suppose the goal is to heat a cup and place it on a table.
Once the cup has been acquired, the next subgoal is to take it to the microwave.
An agent can instead keep searching, choosing actions that are allowed but no longer serve the immediate subgoal.
Labeling this decision as processing tells the student which subgoal the next action should serve.
blocks.zh:
阶段标签解决了多步骤任务中的共同困难:从一个子目标转到下一个子目标.
假设目标是热一杯并放在桌子上。
一旦拿到杯子,下一个次级目标就是带入微波炉.
代理人可以继续搜索,选择允许但不再服务于直接次级目标的行动。
将这一决定标为处理方式,告诉学生下一个行动应服务于哪个次级目标。

blocks.en:
Both compact variants learn to complete tasks from a few hundred demonstrations.
On ALFWorld, a Qwen3-1.7B student reaches 72.4% mean unseen success from 404 demonstrations with either action-only supervision or TPD; both reach 76.9% with 808 demonstrations.
A student trained on reasoning and actions reaches 5.0% at the 404-demonstration budget with free generation, and 48.3% when the same checkpoints use constrained action selection.
Constrained selection recovers much of the reasoning-trained student’s performance, but both compact variants remain ahead under their respective training and execution configurations.
blocks.zh:
两个紧凑的变体都从几百个演示中学习完成任务.
在ALFWorld上,一名Qune3-1.7B学生从404个只接受行动监督或TPD的示威中获得了72.4%的未见成功;808个示威都达到了76.9%。
在404个示范预算中,受过推理和行动培训的学生免费占5.0%,在同一检查站使用受限制的行动选择时占48.3%。
受限制的选拔可以恢复许多经过推理训练的学生的成绩,但这两个紧凑的变体在各自的培训和执行配置下仍然领先.

blocks.en:
The additional benefit of task stages depends on the demonstration budget.
With 200 demonstrations, TPD reaches 67.7% unseen success compared with 48.0% for action-only supervision, a gain of 19.7 percentage points.
The action-only student catches up in mean unseen success at 404 and 808 demonstrations.
We therefore examine both when stages help and which decisions change when the student uses them.
blocks.zh:
任务阶段的额外好处取决于示范预算。
通过200起示威活动,TPD达到了67.7%的未见成功率,而只有行动监督为48.0%,增长了19.7个百分点。
只有行动的学生在404起和808起示威中取得了微不足道的成功。
因此,我们既研究阶段帮助的时间,又研究学生使用阶段改变的决定。

blocks.en:
We investigate this question by comparing trajectories and then testing decisions under the same interaction history.
In processing tasks, one recurring difference appears after the correct object has been acquired: TPD more often starts the required operation.
On selected seen histories, fixing a stage that matches the task’s progress more often leads to an action that advances the task than fixing a mismatched stage.
This sensitivity overlaps with some decisions where TPD makes progress and C does not, mainly in a few heating tasks and with results that depend on the scoring rule.
Across three training seeds on seen tasks, shuffling stage labels across histories also lowers success relative to aligned labels.
Together, the results suggest that task-progress labels help the student learn some transitions between subgoals; with more action demonstrations, C increasingly makes similar choices.
blocks.zh:
我们通过比较轨迹来调查这个问题,然后在相同的相互作用史下测试决定.
在处理任务中,在获得正确的对象后会出现一个反复出现的差异: TPD更经常地开始所需的操作.
在所选的历史中,确定一个与任务进度相匹配的阶段往往会导致一种比确定不匹配阶段更能推进任务的行动。
这种敏感性与TPD取得进展和C不取得进展的一些决定相重叠,主要是在少数取暖任务中,结果取决于打分规则.
在三个关于所见任务的训练种子中,不同历史的打乱舞台标签也比对齐标签降低成功率。
其结果表明,任务进度标签有助于学生学习次级目标之间的一些过渡;随着更多的行动示范,C越来越多地作出类似的选择。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A compact distillation pipeline that combines action-focused supervision, task-stage labels, and admissible-action scoring to train a small agent from fixed teacher demonstrations. • A comparison of reasoning, action-only, and task-progress configurations across demonstration budgets, showing strong compact-agent performance and an additional stage benefit at 200 demonstrations. • A behavioral analysis linking part of TPD’s local advantage to stage-sensitive task transitions, with smaller B/C decision differences as demonstrations increase.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
LM-BUTLER trains language models to predict expert actions and reports strong ALFWorld results, including a few-demonstration setting Micheli and Fleuret (2021) .
FireAct distills trajectories produced by language-model agents, and AgentTuning combines agent interactions with general instruction data Chen et al. (2023) ; Zeng et al. (2024) .
Our action-only student follows this line of work.
It provides a practical agent in its own right and a baseline for measuring the added value of task-stage labels.
blocks.zh:
LM-BUTLER训练语言模型预测专家行动并报告强烈的ALFWorld结果,包括几个演示设置Micheli和Fleuret (2021).
FireAct分馏出由语言模型剂所生成的轨迹,AgentTuning结合了剂相互作用与一般指令数据Chen等 (2023).;Zeng等 (2024).
我们只行动的学生遵循这一行。
它本身就提供了一个实用的代理人,并提供了衡量任务阶段标签附加值的基准。

blocks.en:
These methods also differ in what they ask the student to reproduce.
Structured Agent Distillation separates reasoning and action segments, while OPC-SFT changes the updates assigned to low-probability tokens Liu et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) .
TPD retains the demonstrated action and replaces the long reasoning target with a short task-stage label.
Our reasoning baseline uses ordinary completion supervision; SAD and OPC-SFT introduce specialized training objectives Liu et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) .
SAD also describes online teacher queries during training Liu et al. (2025) ; our student learns from a fixed dataset without further teacher queries.
blocks.zh:
这些方法在要求学生复制的内容上也有不同.
结构化代理 Distillation 将推理和动作部分分开,而OPC-SFT则改变分配给低概率符的更新Liu等(2025);Liu等(2026).
TPD保留了所显示的动作并用一个短的任务阶段标签来取而代之.
我们的推理基线采用普通的完成监督;SAD和OPC-SFT引入了专业培训目标Liu等人(2025);Liu等人(2026)。
SAD还描述了刘等在培训期间的在线教师询问(2025);我们的学生从一个固定数据集中学习,没有进一步的教师询问.

blocks.en:
A fixed dataset may omit states that a student reaches after making a mistake.
Several methods address this by collecting more experience during training.
ETO adds student exploration after SFT, A 3 T combines reasoning annotation with self-training, and HSL relabels collected trajectories Song et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026) .
HPL constructs preferences over trajectories, steps, and action groups, while SAGE-OPD provides selective teacher assistance during on-policy distillation Gao et al. (2025) ; Zhou et al. (2026) .
These methods let the training data reflect the student’s own behavior.
blocks.zh:
固定数据集可能略去一个学生在犯错后到达的表示.
一些方法通过在培训期间收集更多的经验来解决这一问题。
ETO在SFT之后添加了学生探索,A 3 T结合了推理注释和自训,而HSL再贴标签收集了"宋等"(2024年);"杨等"(2024年);"李等"(2026年).
HPL构建了相对于轨迹,步骤和动作组的偏好,而SAGE-OPD则在政策分馏高等等人(2025年);周等(2026年)期间提供选择性的教师援助.
这些方法让培训数据反映学生自己的行为。

blocks.en:
Online agent RL uses rewards from interaction to update the policy.
GiGPO groups decisions to estimate local learning signals, HiPER assigns credit at different planning levels, and STAPO selectively optimizes steps according to their dependence on the trajectory Feng et al. (2025) ; Peng et al. (2026) ; Qi et al. (2026) .
RLVMR uses verifiable meta-reasoning rewards, and EnvRL adds objectives based on environment dynamics Zhang et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026a) .
Our study instead asks what the student can learn from a fixed set of demonstrations, without collecting additional training rollouts.
We use the environment to collect teacher demonstrations and evaluate the student, while student weight updates use only the fixed dataset.
blocks.zh:
在线代理RL使用互动的奖励来更新政策.
GiGPO组合决定估算本地学习信号,HiPER在不同规划级别分配信用,STAPO根据对轨迹冯等(2025)的依赖,有选择地优化步骤;彭等(2026);Qi等(2026).
RLVMR使用可核查的元推理奖励,而EnvRL基于环境动态增加目标 张等 (2025); 王等 (2026a).
我们的研究却问学生可以从一系列固定的示威中学到什么,而不收集更多的训练推广。
我们利用环境来收集教师演示并评价学生,而学生的体重更新只使用固定数据集.

blocks.en:
Task structure can guide learning as well as execution.
HiPER separates planning from execution, and BEACON uses milestones to construct rewards and advantages Peng et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026) .
TPD uses three task-progress labels as supervised targets and as context when scoring the next action.
From History to State studies compact state-based context, while Automata from Agent Traces extracts finite-state structure for prediction and monitoring Xie et al. (2026) ; Cho et al. (2026) .
Our student retains the full action–feedback history.
The stage identifies the current subgoal; the full history still supplies the objects, locations, and feedback needed to choose an action.
blocks.zh:
任务结构可以指导学习和执行。
HiPER将规划与执行区分开来,而BEACON则使用里程碑来构建奖励和优势的彭等 (2026); Wang等 (2026).
TPD将三个任务进度标签作为受监督的目标,并在评分下一步行动时作为上下文。
Automata from Agent Traces 提取了有限的状态结构来预测和监测Xie等人(2026年);Cho等人(2026年)。
我们的学生保留了完整的行动历史。
该阶段确定了目前的分目标;完整的历史仍然提供选择行动所需的对象、地点和反馈。

The action-only student learns this target from the goal and history.

blocks.en:
We train each model with completion-only supervised learning.
Given a target sequence y t y_{t} , the objective minimizes the negative log probability of its supervised tokens: ℒ ( θ ) ∝ − ∑ ( x t , y t ) ∈ 𝒟 ∑ j ∈ ℳ t log p θ ( y t , j ∣ x t , y t , < j ) , \mathcal{L}(\theta)\ \propto\ -\sum_{(x_{t},y_{t})\in\mathcal{D}}\sum_{j\in\mathcal{M}_{t}}\log p_{\theta}(y_{t,j}\mid x_{t},y_{t,<j}), (3) where ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} contains completion positions and excludes system and user tokens.
We apply token-level cross-entropy to the supervised completion tokens.
For TPD, the entire completion—stage, action, and template tokens—is trained jointly, with no separate segment weights.
Longer reasoning targets devote a smaller fraction of supervised tokens to the action.
Training and candidate scoring use the same prompt templates and compact serialization.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We evaluate multi-step task execution in ALFWorld Shridhar et al. (2021) .
The six task families cover picking and placing an object, picking two objects, examining an object under light, and cleaning, heating, or cooling an object.
We train Qwen3-1.7B Yang et al. (2025) on successful demonstrations collected from DeepSeek-v4-pro with the teacher_v2 prompt and temperature 0.7.
The four datasets contain 98, 200, 404, and 808 trajectories.
The 200-, 404-, and 808-trajectory datasets contain 3,712, 7,007, and 13,618 decision records, respectively.
The 808-trajectory dataset retains all original 404 demonstrations and adds 404 more using the planned allocation across task categories.
blocks.zh:
我们评价ALFWorld Shridhar等人(2021年)的多步骤任务执行。
6个任务家庭包括取出和放置物体,取出2个物体,在光线下检查物体,以及清洁、取暖或冷却物体。
我们训练出Quen3 -1.7B 杨等. (2025)关于从DeepSeek-v4-pro收集到的成功演示,教师_v2即时和温度0.7.
四个数据集包含98个,200个,404个和808个轨迹.
200-,404-和808-弹射数据集分别包含有3,712,7,007和13,618个决定记录.
808-弹射数据集保留了所有原有的404个演示,并增加了404个,使用了计划跨任务类别的分配.

blocks.en:
Each independently trained model starts from the same Qwen3-1.7B checkpoint and undergoes three epochs of full-parameter SFT.
We use a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , an effective batch size of 32, and a maximum sequence length of 8,192.
Within each budget, the three seeds (42, 1234, and 2026) share one dataset, and the arms use matching histories and demonstrated actions.
After each epoch, we measure action agreement on a seen probe containing 697 decisions from 35 tasks.
We select the checkpoint with the highest probe action agreement, breaking ties in favor of the earlier epoch.
Appendix A provides the full recipe and software versions.

We first measure how often the compact students complete unseen tasks.
With 404 demonstrations, both C and TPD reach 72.4% mean unseen success; with 808, both reach 76.9% (Table 2 ).
Both variants train on fixed teacher demonstrations and act without teacher assistance during evaluation.
The teacher reference reaches 88.1% (118/134), leaving an 11.2-point gap at 808 demonstrations.
The strong action-only result shows that compact action supervision already provides a useful agent before adding task-stage labels.

这两个变体都对固定教师示威进行培训,并在评估期间在没有教师协助的情况下采取行动。

强有力的只行动结果表明,在添加任务阶段标签之前,紧凑行动监督已经提供了有用的代理人。

The largest observed gain is at 200 demonstrations: B reaches 67.7% mean unseen success and C reaches 48.0%, a difference of 19.7 percentage points.

At 200 demonstrations, this model reaches 51.5% unseen success, compared with 67.7% for B and 48.0% for C.
The constant field does not reproduce B’s advantage at this budget.
At 98 demonstrations, B const B_{\mathrm{const}} reaches 31.6%, below B and C; at 404 and 808, the three means are close.
blocks.zh:
B为C的行动目标增加了一个阶段字段,并更改候选人分数以包括这个字段。
我们首先将每个阶段值替换为恒定的单词相 , 给予 B Const B- mathrm{ const- 。
在200次演示中,这一模式取得了51.5%的未见成功,而B为67.7%,C为48.0%。
不变的领域并不重复B在这个预算中的优势.
在98起示威中,Bconst B_{\-mathrm{const}} 达到31.6%,低于B和C;在404和808起中,三种手段接近.

blocks.en:
B and B const B_{\mathrm{const}} have identical target lengths for every 200-demonstration record: each stage value occupies one token, and the mean completion length is 13.69 tokens.
The constant control also removes label variation, changes the stage instruction, and reduces the candidate set from 3 ​ N 3N to N N .
The shuffled-stage control keeps all three labels and B’s candidate structure, but changes the labels assigned to individual histories.
blocks.zh:
B和B Const B_{\-mathrm{const}}为每200个演示记录都有相同的目标长度:每个阶段值占据了1个令牌,平均完成长度为13.69个令牌.
常数控制还去除标签变异,改变相位指令,将候选设置从3N 3N减为N N.
洗牌阶段控制保留了所有三个标签和B的候选结构,但改变了分配给个人历史的标签。

blocks.en:
B shuffle B_{\mathrm{shuffle}} permutes stage labels among decision records within each task type.
Histories, demonstrated actions, stage counts, and the 3 ​ N 3N candidate structure remain unchanged.
All three training seeds use the same shuffled dataset, constructed with permutation seed 20261006.
Because labels can be permuted onto records with the same original value, 62.55% of shuffled labels still match the originals.
blocks.zh:
B shuffle B_{\- mathrm{ shuffle}}- 在每种任务类型的决策记录中标出阶段标签 。
历史、示范行动、阶段计算和3 N 3N候选人结构保持不变。
所有三种训练种子都使用相同的被洗涤的数据集,由20261006穿透种子所构建.
因为标签可以被穿透到原值相同的唱片上,62.55%被洗牌的标签仍然与原作相匹配.

blocks.en:
Across the 116 seen tasks, B averages 55.2% success and B shuffle B_{\mathrm{shuffle}} averages 37.6% (Table 5 ). The difference is 17.5 percentage points when computed from unrounded success counts.
B leads in all three seeds; C and B const B_{\mathrm{const}} reach 41.4% and 43.7%.
Keeping the label vocabulary and candidate structure is therefore insufficient to retain B’s seen-set performance when the labels are shuffled.
The result supports using labels that match the current task progress.
The comparison also includes the greater difficulty of predicting shuffled labels from the history.
blocks.zh:
在116项已看到的任务中,B的平均成功率为55.2%,B的平均成功率为B_{\-mathrm{shuffle}} 37.6%(表5) 从未四舍五入的成功计算,差额为17.5个百分点。
B领先于所有三种种子;C和Bconst B_{\mathrm{const}达到41.4%和43.7%.
因此,保留标签词汇和候选结构不足以在标签被打乱时保留B的已见设定性能.
结果支持使用与当前任务进度相匹配的标签.
比较还包括从历史中预测被打乱的标签的难度更大.

blocks.en: 4.5 Task Progress and the Next Decision
blocks.zh: 4.5 任务进展和下一个决定

blocks.en:
At 200 demonstrations, B outperforms B const B_{\mathrm{const}} on unseen tasks and B shuffle B_{\mathrm{shuffle}} on seen tasks.
We now examine what the agent does differently.
We first locate behavioral differences in complete trajectories, then hold the history fixed to compare the next action.
blocks.zh:
在200场示威中,B在未见任务上表现优于Bconst B_{\mathrm{const}};在未见任务上表现优于B_{\mathrm{shuffle}}。
我们现在检查特工的用途
我们首先在完整的轨迹中定位行为差异,然后固定历史来比较下个动作.

blocks.en:
At 200 demonstrations, B’s unseen gain over C is largest for heating (+36.2 percentage points), followed by simple picking (+22.2) and cleaning (+20.4).
The gains for picking two objects, looking under light, and cooling are 13.7, 13.0, and 7.9 points.
We use environment feedback to identify when an agent acquires the target, reaches a facility, and performs the required processing.
blocks.zh:
在200起示威中,B在C之上的未见收益在取暖(+36.2个百分点)方面最大,其次是简单的取取暖(+22.2)和清洁(+20.4)。
取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取
我们利用环境反馈来确认某剂何时获得目标,何时到达设施,何时进行所需的处理.

blocks.en:
The heating trajectories show where the policies begin to differ after acquisition.
After acquiring the correct object, B reaches the microwave in 56/58 cases, compared with 32/56 for C.
It successfully heats the object in 55/58 cases, compared with 30/56 for C.
Neither arm had reached the microwave before acquisition in these episodes.
In these episodes, a substantial difference appears between acquiring the object and initiating the required processing.
blocks.zh:
取暖轨迹显示购买后政策开始不同之处。
在获得正确对象后,B在56/58个案例中到达了微波炉,而C则达到32/56个.
它在55/58个案例中成功地加热了此天体,而C的热量则为30/56.
在这些事件中,两只手臂都没有到达微波炉。
在这些事件中,获取对象和启动所需处理之间出现了实质性差异。

blocks.en:
We then restrict the comparison to seed–task pairs in which both agents acquired the correct object (Table 6 ).
B completes heating in 49/52 records and C in 28/52.
Cleaning shows a smaller gap, and cooling shows little difference.
All heating and cleaning attempts in these cohorts succeed when issued, so the main difference at this point is whether the agent initiates processing.
The two agents may still have different histories and remaining steps when they acquire the object. We address this difference by comparing actions on shared histories below.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们将比较限制在种子任务对上,在任务对上,两种物剂都获得了正确的对象(表6)。
B在49/52记录中完成取暖,C在28/52记录中完成取暖.
清理显示的缺口较小,而冷却显示的差别很小.
这些组群中所有的取暖和清洁尝试在发行后都成功,所以此时的主要区别在于该剂是否启动加工.
这两种物剂在获得被物时可能仍然有不同的历史和所剩步骤. 我们通过比较下文关于共同历史的行动来解决这一差异。

blocks.en: Table 6: Successful processing after correct acquisition, restricted to pairs in which both agents acquire the target (200 demonstrations, unseen). Task and training seed are paired; the acquisition-time environment states are not identical.
blocks.zh: 表6:在正确获取后的成功处理,仅限于两种物剂都获得目标的对子(200个演示,看不见). 任务和培训种子成对;获得时间环境状态不尽相同。

blocks.en:
The policies also differ before processing begins.
C also more often picks up the wrong type of object across several task families.
In failed simple-picking episodes, the target never appears in the observation history in 11/24 C cases and 3/8 B cases.
Loops of at least five identical consecutive actions occur at similar overall rates (22.6% for B and 21.9% for C), but in 90/130 B failures and 88/209 C failures.
The gap therefore includes both failure to find or acquire the right object and failure to move on to processing it.
blocks.zh:
在开始处理之前,政策也有所不同。
C也更经常地在多个任务家族中取出错误的对象类型.
在失败的简单挑选事件中,目标从未出现在观察史上11/24 C和3/8 B等案件中.
连续至少5起相同行动的循环发生在类似的总体比率(B为22.6%,C为21.9%),但在90/130 B失败和88/209 C失败中。
因此,差距既包括未能找到或获取正确的对象,也包括未能继续处理它。

blocks.en:
We evaluate B and C on 72 frozen seen prefixes from 50 tasks.
Each prefix ends just before an action, giving both models the same interaction history and admissible actions; only their output-format instructions differ.
We test the 200-, 404-, and 808-demonstration checkpoints for all three seeds.
The pool contains 24 pilot prefixes and 48 additional prefixes sampled without consulting the new scores.
blocks.zh:
我们从50个任务中 评估了72个冷冻的前缀
每个前缀在动作前刚刚结束,给予两个模型相同的交互历史和可接受动作;只有它们的输出格式指示不同.
我们测试200,404,和808的示范检查站,所有三个种子。
游泳池中包含24个飞行员前缀和48个附加前缀的样本,无需查阅新分数.

blocks.en:
We use two tests to examine how B’s stage output affects action selection.
First, we keep the stage in the candidate text but sum only the action-value token scores, excluding stage and JSON-structure scores.
We call this action-value-only scoring.
Second, we fix each possible stage in turn and compare the highest-scoring actions under those stage conditions.
The first test changes which tokens contribute to the score; the second changes the stage on which the action is conditioned.
blocks.zh:
我们用两个测试来检查B的阶段输出如何影响动作选择.
首先,我们保留候选文本中的舞台,但只总结动作值符号分数,不包括舞台和JSON结构分数.
我们称之为行动价值评分。
第二,我们依次确定每个可能阶段,并比较这些阶段条件下得分最高的行动。
第一次测试更改了什么是符号对分数的贡献;第二次修改了动作的附加条件的阶段.

blocks.en:
Removing the non-action score terms changes B’s selected action in 86/648 evaluations (13.3%), across 72 prefixes, three budgets, and three seeds.
Fixing different stage values changes the top action in 130/648 (20.1%).
A blinded review of 36 actions changed by score masking judges 11 changes helpful, six harmful, and 19 undetermined.
Both the stage condition and the score terms can change a choice; the blinded review shows why a changed choice need not be a better one.
On the same prefix set, B/C action agreement rises from about 83% at 200 demonstrations to about 90% at 404 and 808 across the three seeds.
blocks.zh:
在86/648项评价(13.3%)中, 取消非行动分数改变了B的选定行动,
修饰不同阶段值会改变130/648 (20.1%)中的顶部动作.
对36起诉讼的盲目审查 被记分的蒙面法官改变 11起有帮助 6起有害 和19起未定案
舞台条件和分数条件都可以改变一个选择;盲从的审查显示,为什么改变的选择不需要更好。
在同一套前缀上,B/C动作协议从200个示威时约83%上升到了404个和808个三个种子上约90%.

blocks.en:
We next test whether matching the stage to the task’s progress improves the selected action.
For 38 prefixes from 30 tasks, the reference stage is reliable and the rules identify at least one admissible action that makes progress.
Using only the current prefix, the rules classify candidate actions as Progress , Counterproductive , or Undetermined .
For each B checkpoint, we select an action with the matching stage fixed, then repeat with each of the two mismatched stages.
All conditions use action-value-only scoring.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将测试该阶段是否与任务的进展相匹配,从而改进选定的行动。
对于来自30个任务的38个前缀,参考阶段是可靠的,规则确定至少一个可受理的行动,以取得进展.
仅使用当前前缀,规则将候选动作归类为"进步"(Progress),"反效果"(反效果),"或"未定".
对于每个B检查点,我们选择一个动作,设定匹配阶段,然后重复两个不匹配阶段中的每一个.
所有条件都使用动作值唯一的评分.

blocks.en:
At 200 demonstrations, fixing the matching stage yields a progress action in 83.3% of evaluations, compared with 65.4% averaged over the two mismatched stages.
Computed from unrounded counts, the gap is 18.0 percentage points, with positive differences for all three seeds (14.5, 18.4, and 21.1 points). Giving each task equal weight yields a 16.3-point gap.
The clearest differences occur in heating and some visible-target acquisition decisions, while cleaning and cooling subsets are already near saturation.
These rules cover identifiable progress actions, but do not evaluate how well the agent searches for targets it has not yet observed.
blocks.zh:
在200个示范中,确定对应阶段在83.3%的评价中产生了进展,而两个不匹配阶段的平均进展率为65.4%。
根据未圆计数计算,相差18.0个百分点,所有三种种子(14.5分,18.4分和21.1分)都有正差. 赋予每项任务同等重量,就会产生16.3分的差距。
最明显的区别在于取暖和一些可见目标获取决定,而清洁和冷却子集已经接近饱和.
这些规则涵盖可识别的进展行动,但没有评估代理搜索尚未观察到的目标的情况。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 illustrates the decision change with a shared history from the cup task.
On the same history immediately after acquisition, all three B checkpoints at 200 demonstrations choose the microwave, while two of the three C checkpoints continue searching.
All six C checkpoints at 404 and 808 demonstrations choose the microwave.
Across the 38 evaluable prefixes, the matching-stage advantage narrows as demonstrations increase: progress under mismatched stages rises, while progress under the matching stage falls.
The example shows C learning to make a choice that B already makes at 200 demonstrations; the aggregate test shows a smaller effect of fixing the stage at larger budgets.
blocks.zh:
图3用杯子任务的共同历史说明了决定的变化。
同样,在购置后,200个示威游行的所有3个B检查站都选择了微波炉,而3个C检查站中的2个继续搜查。
404和808示威的所有六个C检查站都选择了微波炉。
在38个可评价的前缀中,匹配阶段的优势随着演示的增多而缩小:不匹配阶段下的进展上升,而匹配阶段下的进展下降。
例子显示,C学会了在200个演示中做出B已经做出的选择;汇总测试显示,在更大的预算中固定阶段的效果较小.

重叠分数使用15个仅B级的进展案例作为分母.
覆盖面和打分检查显示有多少任务支持重叠,以及是否在两个打分规则下持续存在。

C chooses it at one of three 200-demonstration checkpoints and all six larger-budget checkpoints.
(b) Across 38 rule-evaluable seen prefixes from 30 tasks, fixing the matching stage more often yields a progress action than fixing a mismatched stage.
Curves show local progress rates averaged over three seeds at each budget.
Table 7 relates these tests to the original B/C choices.
blocks.zh:
图3:从获取对象转向处理. (a) 在获得杯子后的同一历史中,B在所有九个检查站选择微波炉。
C在3个200个示范检查站和所有6个预算较大的检查站中选择。
(b) 在30个任务中,共有38个规则可评价的前缀,比起一个不匹配的阶段,更经常地使匹配阶段产生进步行动。
曲线显示,每个预算的当地进度平均为三个种子。
表7将这些测试与最初的B/C选择有关。

blocks.en:
The fixed-stage tests show which action B selects when we supply a stage.
We now compare B’s normal joint selection with C’s action-only selection on the same 38 prefixes.
At 200 demonstrations, both choose a progress action in 81 of the 114 prefix–seed evaluations, only B in 15, only C in one, and neither in 17.
B’s local progress rate is 84.2%, compared with 71.9% for C; the three seeds contribute five, six, and four B-only cases.
blocks.zh:
固定阶段测试显示,当我们提供一个阶段时,哪个动作B选择.
现在,我们将B的正常联合选择与C的同38个前缀的只行动选择进行比较。
在200个示威中,两人都选择了前114个种子评价中的81个,15个中只有B,1个中只有C,17个中都没有.
B在当地的进展率为84.2%,而C为71.9%;三种种子贡献了5个、6个和4个B级病例。

blocks.en:
In 11 of those 15 B-only cases, the matching-stage action makes progress and at least one mismatched-stage action does not.
In all eleven cases, B’s normal joint selection already chooses the matching stage and the same progress action.
Part of B’s local advantage therefore overlaps with decisions that are sensitive to the stage condition.
The eleven cases come from five prefixes and three tasks; nine cases involve heating at the transform stage.
Only two of the eleven cases preserve B’s selected action when switching from full-joint to global action-value-only scoring (Table 7 ). The overlap is therefore sensitive to the scoring rule.
blocks.zh:
在这15个仅有B级的个案中,有11个个案的对应阶段行动取得了进展,至少有一个对应阶段行动没有取得进展。
在所有11个案例中,B的正常联合选择已经选择了匹配阶段和同样的进度动作.
因此,B的部分当地优势与对阶段条件敏感的决定相重叠。
这11个案例来自5个前缀和3个任务;9个案例涉及改造阶段取暖。
在11个案例中,只有2个在从完全联合到全球行动价值的评分转换时保留了B选定的行动(表7)。 因此,重叠对评分规则很敏感。

blocks.en:
Useful stage sensitivity occurs in 73% of B-only cases, 21% of cases where both policies select progress, and 6% of cases where neither does.
In 16 of the 17 cases where neither policy selects progress, B still selects a non-progress action when the matching stage is fixed.
Fixing the stage alone therefore does not resolve these local failures.
Across 200, 404, and 808 demonstrations, B-only cases decrease from 15 to seven to two, and stage-sensitive cases from 29 to 16 to nine.
blocks.zh:
73%的B类案件,21%的两种政策都选择了进展,6%的B类案件没有取得进展。
在17个没有政策选择进度的案例中,有16个案件中,B在匹配阶段确定后仍然选择非进度行动。
因此,仅仅修复舞台并不能解决这些局部的失败。
在200起、404起和808起示威中,仅B类案件从15起减少到了7起到2起,对阶段敏感的案件从29起减少到了16起到9起。

blocks.en:
The results suggest that task-stage supervision helps with some transitions between subgoals and that the stage condition can guide the next action at those points.
With more demonstrations, C agrees more often with B on the sampled histories, while their mean unseen success rates converge.
These local tests identify decisions consistent with this explanation; determining their contribution to episode success would require closed-loop interventions.
blocks.zh:
结果表明,任务阶段的监督有助于次级目标之间的一些过渡,而且阶段条件可以指导这些阶段的下一步行动。
随着更多的示范,C在抽样历史方面更经常地与B一致,而其不见得的平均成功率则趋同.
这些当地测试确定的决定与这一解释一致;确定这些测试对事件成功的贡献需要封闭式干预。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
The experiments cover one environment and one student model size.
ALFWorld supplies admissible actions, and the student receives the full interaction history.
The annotator supplies task knowledge through hand-defined progress rules.
Using the method in another environment would require suitable progress rules and an interface for constructing admissible actions.
blocks.zh:
实验涵盖一个环境和一个学生模型大小.
ALFWorld提供可受理的行动,学生获得完整的互动历史.
注释员通过手定进度规则提供任务知识.
在另一种环境中使用这种方法将需要适当的进度规则和构建可受理行动的接口。

blocks.en:
Several factors change together in the comparisons.
Reasoning and compact configurations differ in target length, the fraction of action tokens, and the reasoning context used by A constr A_{\mathrm{constr}} during action selection.
The constant-stage control changes candidate count, and shuffling changes label predictability.
Keeping training at three epochs means that larger datasets increase both demonstration coverage and training computation.
Preserving task-category proportions does not control the examples or difficulty within each category.
The current results do not separate these contributions.
blocks.zh:
比较中有几个因素一起变化。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We train small agents to execute multi-step tasks from fixed teacher demonstrations using compact decision targets and admissible-action scoring.
On ALFWorld, both the action-only student and TPD reach 72.4% mean unseen success with 404 demonstrations and 76.9% with 808 using a 1.7B model.
TPD adds its largest observed benefit at 200 demonstrations, raising success from 48.0% to 67.7%; the action-only student matches its mean unseen success at the two larger budgets.
Shared-history tests link some of this local advantage to decisions that advance the task, such as moving to the microwave after acquiring an object that needs heating.
These results establish compact action supervision as a useful baseline and show when explicit task progress adds value in this setting.
blocks.zh:
我们训练小型特工人员执行固定教师示威的多步骤任务,使用紧凑的决定指标和允许行动评分。
在ALFWorld(ALFWorld)上,只行动的学生和TPD都达到了72.4%的隐形成功率,有404次示威,有76.9%的808次使用了1.7B模式.
TPD在200次示威中增加了其最大的观察到的效益,成功率从48.0%提高到67.7%;只行动的学生在两个较大的预算中与它所未见的平均成功率相匹配。
共享历史测试将当地的一些优势与推进任务的决定联系起来,比如在获得需要取暖的物体后转移到微波炉.
这些成果将契约行动监督确立为有用的基准,并表明明确的任务进展在这一背景下会增加价值。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation and Reproducibility Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施和可复制性细节

blocks.en:
The annotator is defined in version 2 of configs/fsm.yaml and implemented in src/annotate_states.py .
It uses the task type and three tracked facts: whether the target is held, whether processing is complete, and whether placement has occurred.
After labeling the current decision, it updates these facts from recognized success messages in the environment feedback.
Heating, cleaning, and cooling require a transformation.
The rules use a fixed object vocabulary and target-inference logic to identify the target. Unsupported action verbs trigger an assertion.

注释器在configs/fsm.yaml 第2版中被定义,并在src/annotate_state.py中被执行.

在标出当前决定后,它从环境反馈中公认的成功信息中更新了这些事实.
取暖、清洁和冷却需要转变。
规则使用固定对象词汇和目标推断逻辑来识别目标. 不支持的动作动词触发一个断言.

blocks.en:
We fine-tune all parameters using bfloat16, scaled dot-product attention, and gradient checkpointing, without LoRA.
We use fused PyTorch AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , cosine decay, 10 warmup steps, and zero weight decay.
The microbatch size is eight, with four gradient-accumulation steps and effective batch size 32.
Sequences are limited to 8,192 tokens.
We train for three epochs and evaluate the seen probe after each epoch.
The epoch with the highest action agreement is selected; ties favor the earlier epoch.
The probe has six tasks from each of five task families and five picking-two tasks, totaling 697 decisions from 35 tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们用bfloat16调整所有参数, 放大点产品注意度, 梯度检查,没有LORA。
我们使用被熔化了的PyTorch AdamW, 学习速度为 10 - 5 10 - 5}, 余弦衰减, 10 个取暖步骤, 零重量衰减。
微批量尺寸为8个,有4个梯度积分步骤和有效批量尺寸为32个.
顺序限制为8,192个符.
我们训练三个纪元 在每个纪元后评估所看到的探测器

探测器从五个任务家族中各有六个任务和五个取出两个任务,总共从35个任务中得出697个决定.

blocks.en:
The loss covers the completion, with system and user tokens masked out.
For TPD, this includes the stage and action values, JSON syntax, the empty thinking block, and the chat-template end-of-message token.
There are no separate loss weights for stage and action tokens.
Training logs record aggregate completion loss, without separate stage and action loss curves.
Dataset construction checks assistant targets against the prompt templates.
Candidate scoring uses the same compact serialization. Prefix-reconstruction checks verify that the scoring inputs match the intended histories.

Scores are sums of completion-token log probabilities, with no length normalization.

blocks.en:
At seed 42, the shuffled model produces legal outputs on 79.5% of 1,870 open-loop records when evaluated by free generation.
An output is counted as legal if it can be parsed, its stage is allowed, and its action belongs to the admissible set.
The shuffled rates at seeds 1234 and 2026 are 82.5% and 84.0%; B’s rates at seeds 42, 1234, and 2026 are 84.1%, 83.2%, and 84.5%.

如果可以解析,允许其阶段,其行为属于可受理的集合,则该产出被算作合法.
种子1234和2026的洗发率分别为82.5%和84.0%;B的种子42、1234和2026的洗发率分别为84.1%、83.2%和84.5%。

blocks.en:
Closed-loop execution selects from candidates built with allowed stages and admissible actions.
Those selected actions are legal by construction.
The free-generation diagnostic measures how often the model produces such an output without candidate selection.

这些选定的行动通过建筑是合法的。

In these runs, the annotator fails when the trajectory never successfully operates on the target object.

blocks.en:
At seed 42, the shuffled model and B have similar open-loop action agreement (49.1% and 48.4%), despite their different closed-loop success rates.
The open-loop test supplies the history and compares one action with a reference.
In closed-loop execution, each policy must also handle the histories created by its earlier choices.

在封闭式执行中,每项政策还必须处理其先前的选择所创造的历史。

blocks.en:

The 62.55% agreement between shuffled and original labels describes the training data.
